other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal.
Applicant must be enrolled in the Employment Bank of Labour Department, GOWB.
Family income must be less than ₹25000 per month.
More than one member of the same family is not eligible.
Age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of 30% of the ex‑showroom price of a commercial vehicle, up to a maximum of ₹1,00,000.
